summary: Mal/2 is a 1957 album by American jazz pianist Mal Waldron, released on the Prestige label. The note says the CD reissue added two bonus tracks from the same sessions, which were originally released on the album The Dealers (1957).
one_line: Mal/2 is a 1957 jazz album by pianist Mal Waldron on Prestige, whose CD reissue added two bonus tracks from The Dealers sessions.
key_facts: Mal/2 is an album by American jazz pianist Mal Waldron.
Mal/2 was released on the Prestige label.
The CD reissue of Mal/2 added two additional recordings as bonus tracks.
The two bonus tracks on the Mal/2 CD reissue come from the same sessions as the album The Dealers.
The two bonus tracks were originally released on The Dealers (1957).
